Load a ResolveDataset from in-memory data frames

Source: R/resolve.R
resolve.dataset.frame.Rd

In-memory analog of resolve.dataset.csv(). Builds and encodes a dataset directly from data frames already in R, without writing them to a CSV first, for a header filtered or subset before a fit. The result is identical to resolve.dataset.csv() on the equivalent CSV.

Usage

resolve.dataset.frame(
  header,
  species = NULL,
  roles = list(),
  targets = list(),
  config = list(),
  schemaSource = NULL,
  vocabs = NULL,
  names = NULL,
  maxEditDistance = 1L
)

Arguments

header

A data.frame of header data (one row per plot). In single-table mode (species = NULL) this is instead the long-format species frame, whose first row of each plot carries the plot's coordinates and targets (covariates need a header).

species

A data.frame of species data (long format), a single file path string (the large species table is then read once from disk while the header stays in memory), or NULL for single-table mode.

roles

Named list mapping roles to column names (see resolve.dataset.csv()).

targets

Named list of target specifications.

config

Named list of dataset configuration options.

schemaSource

Optional ResolveDataset whose vocabularies / class mappings are reused (see resolve.dataset.csv()).

vocabs

Optional vocabulary list from predictor$vocabs() (see resolve.dataset.csv()). Mutually exclusive with schemaSource.

names, maxEditDistance

Resolve the species names first (see resolve.dataset.csv()).

Value

A ResolveDataset object.

See also

resolve.dataset.csv()
